summary: Third iteration — full validation of new INGESTIONE COMUNICAZIONI INFORMALI module (Agent A6). Backend: added TestCommunications class (7 tests, all PASS) to /app/backend/tests/test_juspatrimonium.py covering: /api/compliance/consent-text (contains 'art. 2712' + 'art. 24'), /api/communications/upload consent enforcement (400 without consent), PII masking (masked_preview contains '*** ****'), institutional role detection ('Assessore Cultura' -> 'Rappresentante istituzionale'), list & GET (no _id leak), A6 contradiction analysis (returns discrepanze[], prospetto[] with all 4 required keys data_ora/interlocutore/estratto/rilevanza_vizio, clausola_2712 containing 'art. 2712'), /api/communications/analyses/latest, and Fascicolo snapshot integration (snapshot.communications with clausola + prospetto rendered inside PDF). Frontend: end-to-end verified via Playwright — (a) admin login -> nav-tab-communications -> /app/comunicazioni renders communications-view + comm-guide-tooltip + comm-consent-checkbox; (b) uploading WHATSAPP .txt WITHOUT consent triggers Italian error toast 'Accetta la dichiarazione di conformità privacy per procedere' and blocks upload; (c) after consent + upload the item appears in Comunicazioni acquisite (3 msg parsed); (d) 'Analizza Contraddittorio' button renders probative-table with 4-column prospetto + discrepanza cards + art. 2712 clause + copy-clause-button; (e) DocumentAnalysis /app/documenti shows comm-link-card with go-to-communications navigating back to /app/comunicazioni; (f) admin generates draft -> request-asseverazione-button creates casefile -> lawyer login -> newest casefile in /lawyer-portal shows lawyer-prospetto column with all rows AND download-fascicolo-button returns a valid 12.9KB PDF (200).
critical_code_review_comments: comms.mask_pii: _PHONE_RE is greedy (r'\+?\d[\d\s().\-]{7,}\d') and may accidentally match sequences that include date/time digits when they touch numbers on the same line; current test text is safe but consider anchoring to the start of the number token to avoid rare false positives.
comms.py enrich_messages uses a for/else block on the role_kw loop — subtle Python idiom; a helper 'detect_role(mittente)' would improve readability.

server.py:608 always overrides snapshot.communications with the latest comm_analysis for the owner, regardless of whether the fascicolo relates to that analysis; acceptable for MVP but consider linking analyses to a specific job_id/case.
server.py: /api/communications/analyze uses default max_tokens=2600 for the A6 LLM; ~40s latency observed. If frontend UX is a concern add optimistic progress steps like orchestrator bus.
server.py still 866 lines and mixes 7 concerns (auth, docs, orchestrator, damage, generator, vault, casefiles, lawyers, communications) — should be split into APIRouters (unchanged from iter 2).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all specified flows (consent gate, upload, analyze, prospetto, art.2712 clause+copy, DocumentAnalysis card, lawyer fascicolo integration + PDF download)
